summary: The source keeps the full CSR matrix resident and launches one scalar thread per row in each requested iteration. Each thread checks its row bound, scans the complete CSR interval and stores the sum. The timed compiled host loop has its repetition backedge and actual kernel launch, followed by synchronization before timer end. CMake selects sm_70, matching the final SASS architecture.
